about_title: CNC and NC press brakes at a price a small shop can justify
about_text: NovoTech's value line is our own brand: machines built in China to our specification with European and Japanese controls and hydraulics — Delem, Estun, Hawe, Rexroth, Schneider, Siemens, NOK — inspected before they ship and sold under NovoTech's name with the same CSA-approved panel, 1-year warranty and parts and technical support from Mississauga, Ontario, as every machine we sell.

The CNC press brakes in this catalogue use electro-hydraulic servo synchronisation with Hawe valves and linear scales, a servo-driven pump that runs only while the ram moves, a Delem DA-53T control and a servo back gauge on ball screws — the architecture of the European machines, from 55 to 331 US tons over 4 to 20 ft, with heavy-duty and tandem machines to 1,323 tons and 26 ft. The NC press brakes keep the two cylinders in step with a torsion bar and set the depth on mechanical stops, with an Estun E21 control for the back gauge and 40 stored programs: the simple, rugged brake for brackets, boxes, channels and roofing, from 33 to 441 tons.
